members.name: value
members.description: RadioGroup uses a generic value/defaultValue and onValueChange(value,eventDetails), plus disabled/readOnly/required/name/form. RadioGroupItem inherits the exact Radio.Root props including value and disabled. The default visible root is span role=radio with a hidden native radio input, not a visible native radio. Checked value is singular; choosing the checked item does not clear the group. Disabled/readOnly suppress user changes; callback cancellation can veto and controlled props stay authoritative.

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Actual cancellable source React callback, preserving eventDetails and native event. Controlled props remain authoritative.
